about: Runs of the Sneeze world tiles by people who had Sneeze or Artemis, as REPORTED by them (not tamper-proof). Written only by spatial/sneeze_kit/ingest.py. The status tables below are a function of the runs: "proposed" until a run observed it, then "observed in <engine> <version>"; no stronger word is ever written. With run_count 0 nothing has been loaded in Sneeze or Artemis.

field_status.field: manifest.Modules[0].sUrl = the stock map module on the RP1 CDN

field_status.observed_means: the engine loaded a manifest that carries the Data.Anchors block without error; it does NOT mean the engine uses the block
the engine loaded a manifest that carries the Data.Provenance block without error; it does NOT mean the engine uses the block
in a loaded multi-tile manifest every tile appeared and sat where its recorded east/north offset puts it relative to the first tile, as seen on screen

field_status.field: GeoPose anchor consumed by any Sneeze component
field_status.observed_means: the person saw the engine use Data.Anchors (place the world by it, display it or log it)

field_status.field: attaching one manifest to another (child fabrics)
field_status.observed_means: cannot be observed with the manifests built here

field_status.field: camera / render scale at 10-100 km tile extents
field_status.observed_means: a tile at least 10 km across appeared and the person judged its size to match the checklist table

field_status.field: a tile this size loads inside Sneeze's frame budget
field_status.observed_means: the largest tile appeared and the camera stayed smooth on one person's machine in one run
cannot be observed with the manifests built here (none is signed)
